review_candidates.description_excerpt: The Implementation Support Engineer serves as a primary technical resource for healthcare IT customer projects, with a focus on implementing, supporting, and maintaining PACS/RIS solutions and related healthcare technologies. The role combines hands-on technical troubleshooting, customer support, system implementation and maintenance, cross-functional collaboration, and proactive communication to ensure successful deployments and a high-quality customer experience.
